seo.title: Contact growthGrid | Start Your Software Project
seo.description: Tell growthGrid what you're building. We read every inquiry personally and reply within one business day with a clear next step, wherever you're based.

hero.headline: Let's build something *that lasts*
hero.lede: Every great project starts with a conversation. Tell us what you're planning, what you're solving, or where you want to go. We'll help you find the right way forward.

form.servicesLabel: What do you need help with?
form.messagePlaceholder: What are you building, who is it for, and what would success look like?
form.successMessage: A senior member of the team will reply within one business day. Keep an eye on your inbox (and your spam folder, just in case).
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong sending your message. Please try again, or email us directly.
form.privacyNote: We only use your details to reply to this inquiry. See our [privacy policy](/privacy).
form.heading: Project inquiry
form.planMessage: Hi! I'd like a quote for the {plan} care plan.

errors.nameMax: That name is a little long.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.messageMin: Tell us a little more, at least 20 characters.
errors.summary: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.rateLimited: You've sent several messages in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again, or email us directly.

items.title: We review your inquiry
items.description: We understand your goals and respond within one business day.

items.title: A 30-minute intro call
items.description: We dig into your goals, constraints and timeline, and tell you honestly whether we're the right fit.

items.title: A clear proposal
items.description: You get a scoped plan with milestones, team and a fixed estimate, usually within a week.
